name: two-tip
title: Two tip
description: Zenith's starter example auto (examples/starter collect-and-score), tuned to BioHORS: shoot the four preloads from the south, which tips the hive (3 nectar staged in the up cell); go round the west of the hive to flower1 and score its four in the north cell; sweep the RED garden line west and score its four north for the second tip. The flower bar goes down only to collect from the flower.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: The team (2026-11-06): the intake runs at MechanismConstants.AUTO_INTAKE_POWER (0.6, SET BY HAND) the whole AUTO, from here to the park. Between volleys it keeps pulling in and the shut gate holds the pollen; after each volley ScoreCommand keeps it running without counting it, and intakeOnFlower / intakeOnGarden start counting again at each pickup.
A straight line north to the scoring spot south of the hive, facing its up cell.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 1: the four preloads into the south cell; the third tips it (3 nectar staged there, season tip table) and the fourth goes in as it starts to swing.

control.provenance: SET BY HAND (2026-11-06, the team: a gentle curve round the hive that splits the gap between the frame and a partner robot): with (-50.6, -3) and (-46.8, 19.5), as driven in the sim (ZenithAutoMatchTest's trace, both alliances) the stowed-bar footprint keeps 4.0 in from the hive frame and 4.6 in from the 18 in strip along the west wall beside RED's loading zone (x >= -52.67, y 23.9..54.6) where a partner robot may stand. Tuned in the sim against the heading Pedro actually drives (Foresight turns up to about 12 in early); not driven on the robot yet
SET BY HAND (2026-11-06, split the gap): see the first control point
SET BY HAND (2026-11-06, split the gap): see the first control point

steps.notes: After the tip the up cell faces north, and a launch only scores from the up cell's own quarter of the field, so the robot goes to the other side of the hive. It goes around the west of the hive frame, not under it: the frame's west legs keep an 18 in robot's centre east of about x = -9, and its footprint is 18 in wide, so under the hive it would cross the centre line into BLUE's side (G402). It keeps facing north while it leaves the scoring spot, turns to drive nose-first once its footprint is clear of the centre line, and turns back to face north for the flower. Pedro reads a piece's end as a fraction of the path's length and hands a tangent piece its own 0..1 t, so the starter's tangent spans are written as linear pieces between the curve's true direction every tenth of the path (tools/zenith_headings.py); each piece starts on the heading the last one ended on, so the robot never spins on the spot. speedFraction 0.6 (SET BY HAND, 2026-11-06, the team: go slow through the 28 in lane between the hive frame and a partner robot by the loading zone); the cap is Pedro's maxVelocityConstraint, 36 in/s at MAX_FORWARD_IN_PER_S 60.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: The intake is already running (intakeOnAll); this marks the flower pickup, so the pollen estimate counts from here (between pickups it runs without counting).

steps.name: flowerBarDown
steps.notes: Puts the flower bar down to reach into flower1's opening.

The team: drop the flower bar, THEN drive in to intake. Waits for the bar to swing all the way down before the robot moves toward the flower (PLACEHOLDER 0.5 s = MechanismConstants.FLOWER_BAR_DROP_S; the sim's servo takes 0.38 s).

Drives slowly all the way in to flower1 with the intake running and the bar down (0.2, SET BY HAND, the team: slower, and in closer). It no longer stops early when the hopper reads full: it always reaches the pickup, and expect tells the ledger it takes the flower's four pollen. Heading held square to the wall (a tangent heading turns a small sideways offset into a yaw that swings the mouth off the opening).
Gives the intake up to 1.5 s more (SET BY HAND, the team: longer at the flower). A wait until ends as soon as its condition is true, and timeoutS stops it waiting forever.
SET BY HAND (the team): holds the intake running and the bar down 0.5 s more after the hopper reads full, so a last pollen still in the mouth comes in before the bar lifts.

steps.notes: The starter's leg: backs straight off flower1 still facing it for the first fifth (turning at once swings a corner into the flower's foot), then turns round through west and comes in to the scoring spot north of the hive facing south, the launcher toward the up cell. Pedro reads a piece's end as a fraction of the path's length and hands a tangent piece its own 0..1 t, so the starter's tangent spans are written as linear pieces between the curve's true direction every tenth of the path (tools/zenith_headings.py); each piece starts on the heading the last one ended on, so the robot never spins on the spot.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Volley 2: four flower pollen into the north cell (up after tip 1). The flower bar stays down the whole drive back; the volley lifts it to its shooting position.

steps.name: flowerBarStow
steps.notes: Folds the flower bar up after the volley, for the rest of the route (the team: down until the shooting spot, then up to shoot).

steps.notes: The starter's curve back south round the west of the hive, tuned to BioHORS (CAD footprint: bar tip 14.2 in ahead of the drive centre, back 7.8 in behind, 17.84 in wide); ending heading west above the garden lane instead of turning to west on it. Pedro reads a piece's end as a fraction of the path's length and hands a tangent piece its own 0..1 t, so the starter's tangent spans are written as linear pieces between the curve's true direction every tenth of the path (tools/zenith_headings.py); each piece starts on the heading the last one ended on, so the robot never spins on the spot. speedFraction 0.6 (SET BY HAND, 2026-11-06, the team: go slow through the 28 in lane between the hive frame and a partner robot by the loading zone); the cap is Pedro's maxVelocityConstraint, 36 in/s at MAX_FORWARD_IN_PER_S 60.
Slides down onto the garden lane still facing west, slowly so it stops on time: near the south wall the 22 in robot must stay square to it.

steps.name: intakeOn
steps.notes: The intake is already running (intakeOnAll); this marks the garden pickup, so the pollen estimate counts from here (between pickups it runs without counting).

The starter's sweep west along the RED garden line, intake toward the red alliance wall, taking the pollen in a line. It always runs to its end: cut short when full, the robot rolls on into the west wall. Slower than the starter's 0.3 (0.2, SET BY HAND, the team's call): every pollen in the row has time to go in.
Up to 0.8 s more for the last pollen.
Up off the lane still facing west (square to the south wall), to where it can turn.

steps.notes: North around the west of the frame, east along the north side of the hive and down to the scoring spot north of it, turning to face the up cell. It does the turn west of x = -13, and the last stretch is a straight drive south, so its footprint stays on RED's side of the centre line (G402). Pedro reads a piece's end as a fraction of the path's length and hands a tangent piece its own 0..1 t, so the starter's tangent spans are written as linear pieces between the curve's true direction every tenth of the path (tools/zenith_headings.py); each piece starts on the heading the last one ended on, so the robot never spins on the spot. speedFraction 0.6 (SET BY HAND, 2026-11-06, the team: go slow through the 28 in lane between the hive frame and a partner robot by the loading zone); the cap is Pedro's maxVelocityConstraint, 36 in/s at MAX_FORWARD_IN_PER_S 60.
A deadline group ends when its deadline member, the drive, ends. Beside it, after half a second off the garden, the launcher spins up on the way back. The intake keeps running all AUTO.

steps.name: score
steps.notes: Four more pollen into the north cell, which now holds 8, so the hive tips a second time.

steps.notes: After the last volley (the team's sketch): out toward the north wall, then west along it past flower1, turning from facing the hive to facing the field (east; counter-clockwise, a quarter turn) on the way, to a spot straight north of the park spot.
Slides south into the park spot, back to the west wall and the intake facing the field: where the teleop starts (MainHorsTeleOp's default start pose).
